searchArea.hint: Jobs outside this area are skipped before anything opens (remote jobs always count). Measured from the ZIP below, or your address ZIP if empty.

education.title: Education

coverLetter.title: Cover Letter
coverLetter.description: Default cover letter template used when applications request one.
coverLetter.placeholder: Write your default cover letter here...

notes.title: Instructions for the AI
notes.hint: The agent follows these on every application, like rules. Describe how you want forms handled; your profile and resume already supply the facts.
notes.placeholder:
For example:
- Usual flow: open the job page, click Apply, create an account if needed, then fill in personal info, address, experience and questions.
- Prefer 'Apply with resume' or autofill options when offered, then check every field.
- Put my street address in Address Line 1 and leave Line 2 empty.
- Answer 'No' to optional marketing emails.

screening.title: Screening Answers
screening.hint: Answers to questions many applications ask. Leave the voluntary ones (gender, race, veteran, disability) empty to always decline to answer.

jobSearch.title: Job search
jobSearch.hint: What the job collector looks for. The Collect page starts from these, and you can change them there for one search.
jobSearch.modeQuickHint: Reads whole results pages: about one AI request per page of jobs.
jobSearch.modeDetailedHint: Opens each job in turn: one AI request per job, judged closely against your notes.
jobSearch.minPayHint: Hourly, weekly and monthly pay is turned into a yearly estimate to compare. Jobs paying less aren't collected. Empty: no minimum.
jobSearch.partTimeHoursHint: For a part-time job's yearly estimate when the posting doesn't say.
jobSearch.matchHint: AI judges relevance using your notes, profile and desired role, including related titles. Explicit exclusions and pay requirements are checked separately.
jobSearch.noPayBar: Jobs that don't list pay need {{bar}} or more.
jobSearch.notes: Notes for the AI that finds jobs
jobSearch.notesHint: In your own words: what you want and what you don't. The AI uses these to judge relevance. Use explicit exclusions for requirements that must always be enforced.
jobSearch.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Clinics or hospitals, no night shifts, nothing that needs a car.
